nodes.label: Atria Dawn Preview Model
nodes.rationale: 744-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts foundation agentic language model trained via Verifiable Experience Pipeline

nodes.label: Verifiable Experience Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Connects tasks and agent trajectories to artifacts and externally verified outcomes; only experience with verified evidence incorporated

nodes.label: Human-AI Collaboration in R&D
nodes.rationale: Analysis of 769 task records from 56 participants; AI proposed 64.6% of methods but humans made final choice in 85.5%

nodes.label: Evolution of Human-AI Roles
nodes.rationale: Three stages: research object (full human control), task-level runner (human-designed workflows), project-level coworker (autonomous planning)

nodes.label: Open Challenge 1: Diverse Research Directions
nodes.rationale: How could AI keep generating diverse research directions and assess their potential value before results are available?

nodes.label: Open Challenge 2: Recursive Experience Transformation
nodes.rationale: AI must recursively transform experiences from extended exploration into intrinsic research capabilities

nodes.label: Open Challenge 3: Human Oversight at Scale
nodes.rationale: As AI reveals possibilities beyond human imagination, how can humans formulate meaningful goals and maintain effective oversight?

nodes.label: Open Challenge 4: Authority Allocation and Alignment
nodes.rationale: Need clear protocols for authority allocation and alignment standards as AI systems begin to lead most R&D
